data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for the Google Cloud gRPC Speech-to-Text API.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to communicate with the Google Cloud Speech-to-Text API using gRPC. It supports audio transcription via file recognition, real-time streaming recognition, and endless stream support.
use_when: You need to transcribe audio files to text using Google Cloud Speech-to-Text in a Flutter app.
You require real-time streaming audio transcription or endless stream support.
avoid_when: You need local, on-device speech-to-text processing without a cloud backend.
You cannot configure Google Cloud credentials, service accounts, or tokens.
strengths: Pure Dart implementation utilizing gRPC for streaming transcription support.
Supports multiple authentication methods including service accounts, tokens, and third-party authenticators.
Supports Google Speech V1, Beta, and V2 APIs.
weaknesses: Requires an active Google Cloud account and properly configured credentials.
Streaming audio quality issues or incorrect formats can lead to empty API responses.
data.setup_notes: Requires creating a Google Cloud account, activating the Speech API, generating a service account JSON file, and configuring permissions/credentials in the app.
